description: This file defines the 'HomeScreen' composable for an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It displays a list of user profiles with options to add new profiles via a floating action button and to open existing profiles by clicking on profile cards. The code includes UI components, data binding with a repository, and preview functions for both light and dark themes.

classes.description: Provides sample profile data for UI previews.
